title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
description:
Description
 SundaySky is the leading enterprise video personalization platform for CX, Marketing, Sales, and more. The company's mission is Unlocking Video for Business: empowering teams to deploy data-rich video programs that drive valuable outcomes. Our customers have achieved breakthrough results from personalized video including:
 Healthcare: Member health engagement — personalized video communications driving participation in wellness programs, preventive care, and chronic condition management. Outcomes: 271% increase in response rates, 800% increase in digital engagement, 2x improvement in customer health scores.
 Financial Services: Financial literacy and vesting education — explaining vesting schedules, catch-up contributions, and investment basics. Outcomes: 3x plan enrollment rates vs. traditional communications, 2x deferral increases.
 Banking: Digital banking adoption — video education driving enrollment in online banking, mobile app, eStatements, and bill pay. Outcomes: 12–15% increase in digital enrollment.
 Results like these are made possible by close partnership between SundaySky 's customers and our Customer Success team. In this role, you'll work with some of our largest enterprise customers in health plans, financial services and insurance. You'll help them launch successful programs that are attributable to clear and defensible business value. The ideal candidate has a SaaS Customer Success background with experience defining and executing on strategic plans and working with strategic enterprise customers to repeatedly deliver measurable value in a high touch motion.
 Responsibilities
 Serve as a strategic consultant to enterprise customers, helping them design, deliver, and measure personalized video programs.
 Build relationships across every level of the account: day-to-day users, program owners, and executive sponsors in the business unit.
 Run the full lifecycle for new enterprise customers, from kickoff and onboarding through the first proof of value and on to renewal.
 Find and launch the next use case in each account by bringing in new teams and new customer journeys.
 Develop deep platform expertise and apply it to help each customer reach their goals.
 Build the value case for each renewal from achieved and measured business outcomes such as renewal rates, enrollment, and call deflection, rather than from platform usage statistics.
 Own renewals and add-ons for your book against a renewal quota. Keep your forecast current with confidence levels, start renewal planning 120 days out, and partner with Account Directors on larger expansion opportunities.
 Partner with the product team to share market feedback to aid the development and prioritization of the roadmap.
 Requirements
 At least 5 years in customer success or account management, including 3 or more years managing enterprise accounts.
 You've led executive business reviews with VP and C-level sponsors, built mutual success plans with them, and walked them through outcome data.
 You prove value by measuring outcomes against a baseline or a comparison, not by reporting usage or adoption. You've designed A/B tests, holdout comparisons, or attribution methods that tie performance to business outcomes. We teach our specific approach in onboarding.
 You've carried an individual renewal quota as a number in your own comp plan, not a target shared across a team. Experience carrying an upsell or add-on quota is a plus.
 You've taken enterprise renewals through complex procurement, security reviews, and competitive RFPs.
 You've worked with enterprise customers in regulated industries such as health plans, retirement and wealth management, insurance, or banking, and you understand how legal and compliance review shape what ships and when.
 Nice to have 
 Customer Success experience at a creative software company (video, design, media/ads). Our customers build their videos using our creative tools, and you'll train them on it and answer their how-to questions.
 Familiarity with video distribution and measurement including embeds, viewership metrics, and video engagement optimization (or a willingness to learn).
 Compensation: $110,000–$130,000 plus variable compensation.
 SundaySky is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees .

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Homestead Studio 
We are an email marketing agency specializing in growing eCommerce brands by creating exciting, engaging, and personalized messaging across email and SMS channels. Our expertise in email and SMS marketing allows our clients to cultivate relationships with potential customers and build lasting relationships with current customers to create lifetime value.
 About the role
 Client Success at Homestead is about two things. First, giving our teams what they need to own their clients' outcomes and do their best work. Second, making sure every brand we work with has the best experience possible, with someone in their corner who listens, advocates for them, and makes things right when they go sideways. In this role, you're that person for both.
 As our Client Success Manager, you'll be the person our DTC clients and delivery teams turn to when a relationship gets hard. You'll cover a portfolio of about 30 brands across email & SMS and paid social, and most weeks bring a handful of urgent issues that need same-day attention.
 Your job is to figure out what's really going wrong, fix it with the team, and make sure the fix holds. We'll train you on how our email and paid work gets made, so you can explain what's happening to a founder plainly and honestly. You'll work closely with our leadership team and have the chance to lead communication and other training to share your expertise with the wider team. This isn't a sales or renewal role.
 Responsibilities
 Escalations. Take in urgent issues from clients and the team, separate facts from assumptions, and build a fix rather than passing the problem along.
 Client resets. Lead issue and reset calls with founders and marketing leads and turn scattered feedback into one point of contact and one combined revision round.
 Key moments. Open and close every creative kickoff and check in one month after kickoff and two weeks after any team change.
 Team transitions. Guide clients through strategist and account manager changes so important context isn't lost.
 Portfolio health. Keep our client tracker current, reach out to quiet accounts, and run a post-mortem whenever a client leaves.
 Team support. Catch workload concerns early, spot patterns across weeks, and raise staffing or scope issues with leadership.
 Clear updates. After each touchpoint, send a recap to the client, to leadership and to the account team.
 Training. Lead communication training for strategists, designers, copywriters and account managers to improve the team as you spot patterns.
 Qualifications
 Experience with agency production (approval flows, revision rounds, Asana, Figma) or tools like Klaviyo and Meta Ads Manager is a bonus, not a requirement. You won't write copy, build campaigns or manage day-to-day timelines, but you'll understand all three well enough to see what's going wrong.
 Emotionally intelligent. You read people well, and clients and teammates leave conversations with you feeling heard. This matters more than anything else on this list.
 Great at navigating conflict. You stay calm in tense moments, aren't afraid of a hard conversation, and find solutions that work for both sides.
 Someone who lifts the team up. You know how to have fun at work, bring good energy on hard days, and leave people better off after working with you.
 Experienced with clients. You have a few years in client success, account management or another client-facing role. Agency or DTC experience is a plus.
 A clear, warm communicator. Your writing is concise, separates facts from assumptions, and fits the audience.
 Organized. You can juggle several priorities at once, keep trackers current, and follow through without reminders.
 Curious and coachable. You don't need to be an ecommerce expert. We'll train you on what we deliver and how it works, and you'll pick up the rest on the job.
 Additional Information 
 This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be able to work standard business hours (9:00am–5:00pm) in ET, CT, MT, or PT time zones.
 Homestead Studio is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Homestead is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. 
 Note on Application Responses 
We strongly encourage applicants to answer questions in their own words. While tools like ChatGPT can be helpful for organizing or polishing your thoughts, it is very easy to recognize when responses are copied and pasted without personalization. Candidates who use AI in that way are typically less successful in our process. Please treat your responses as an opportunity to show us how you think and communicate.
